description: This file defines the Category controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, handling CRUD operations, listing, form rendering, and other management functions for product categories in the catalog.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class for managing categories within the Opencart admin interface, providing methods for listing, editing, saving, activating, deactivating, deleting, repairing, and autocompleting categories.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for category management page; loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, loads necessary data, and renders category list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList controller method to load the list of categories.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats a list of categories based on filters like name, store, language, status, and sorting options; handles pagination and returns a view with the category list.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares data for the category creation/edit form, including descriptions, filters, images, SEO URLs, layouts, and options, then renders the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or edited category data, including validation, SEO URL processing, and permission checks; returns JSON response.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected categories; changes their status to active after permission check, returns JSON response.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected categories; changes their status to inactive after permission check, returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected categories after permission validation; returns JSON response.

methods.name: repair
methods.description: Repairs category hierarchy structure; invoked by admin to fix potential inconsistencies.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an autocomplete list of categories based on filter_name input for AJAX suggestions.
